name: TC-494: the owner's Dual Pricing toggle is disabled until an admin sets the card markup; the Confirm-menu dialog previews the card/cash table and names no rate
description: Admin enrolls the shared restaurant WITHOUT a markup → Order Settings shows the toggle disabled with the 'contact RestauNax' warning and both actions disabled. Admin sets 3.5% → after reload the toggle is offered (no rate is shown anywhere on the owner's screen), and 'Confirm menu prices…' opens a preview whose table carries Card price / Cash price columns and whose confirm stays disabled behind the acknowledge checkbox (never ticked). If the shared menu was converted in an earlier run the button is disabled and the 'Menu converted on' caption is asserted instead. Everything is restored in finally.
